proposals.title: Civil Rights, Non-Discrimination and Returns to Merit Audit
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an audit analyzing impacts of the Company's DEI policies on civil rights, non-discrimination and returns to merit, and a publicly disclosed report.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, the Board recommends that our shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Production of a Report on BlackRock's Ability to "Engineer Decarbonization in the Real Economy"
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on whether and how BlackRock could improve pension clients' returns by focusing stewardship and proxy voting on decarbonizing the real economy.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, the Board recommends that our shareholders vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Impact Report for Climate-Related Human Risks of iShares U.S. Aerospace and Defense Exchange-Traded Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on potential material risks to all stakeholders of the ITA ETF, focusing on global human and environmental cost of investing in it.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, the Board recommends that our shareholders vote AGAINST the proposal.
